headline: Schefter: NFL draft, new stadium factored in Nashville getting Super Bowl
description: Adam Schefter reacts to Nashville being selected to host the Super Bowl in 2030.

headline: Would an NFL team take a chance on Brendan Sorsby in supplemental draft?
description: Adam Schefter and Tim Hasselbeck evaluate Brendan Sorsby's prospects in the supplemental draft if he's not able to play in college.

headline: NFL awards three-day 2028 draft event to Minneapolis
description: Minneapolis has been awarded the 2028 NFL draft with U.S. Bank Stadium serving as a "foundational piece" of the three-day event.

headline: How Matt Stover discovered new Packers kicker Trey Smack
description: Smack, the only kicker drafted in 2026, left lacrosse behind after a single kick of a football.
